headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief - 4 November 2026
summary: Ethereum leads TVL at 44.5 billion USD, followed by Base at 6.0 billion USD and Solana at 5.4 billion USD. Uniswap V3 recorded 1.12 billion USD in 24-hour DEX volume while Tether generated 16.9 million USD in fees. USDT holds 178.1 billion USD circulating supply with several stablecoins showing depeg alerts. Base reports 14.6 billion USD TVS among L2s amid multiple security incidents in the prior fortnight.
